newsitem.title: INDIA: Profit-taking pulls down Bombay stocks at close.
newsitem.headline: Profit-taking pulls down Bombay stocks at close.

text.p: ** (1015 GMT) - Blue-chips end in negative territory after
** Profit-booking before the start of Christmas holidays
** Index fall snaps out market's six-day winning streak
** Benchmark Bombay share index drops 18.30 pts, or 0.59
pct, to end at a provisional 3,091.89
** National bourse index down 0.39 pct to 880.95
Share prices closed with small losses at Bombay bourses on Monday, after an expected bout of profit-taking capped price gains, dealers said.
"There was some profit-taking, but market action was more or less flat," said Balaji Narayan, dealer at Prime Broking, a domestic firm.
"Volumes were pretty decent.. not much of fund activity."
Hesitancy on the part of operators to leave outstanding positions in a shortened trading week led to the squaring up mood, dealers said.
"Nobody's willing to take up fresh positions..a small correction was also long overdue," said Sanjeev Choithani, chief dealer at brokerage firm Pashupati Advani.

The market has rallied 229.93 points, or nearly 8.0 percent in six sessions on fresh political developments in the Congress party. The party is to elect a new chief of its parliamentary bloc after former premier P.V. Narasimha Rao quit last week.

The Bombay Stock Exchange (BSE) and most other bourses close for Christmas holiday from Wednesday. The BSE re-opens on January 1, but the National Stock Exchange will resume trade on Thursday, close on Friday and re-open on December 31.
The BSE's 30-share index fell 18.30 points, or 0.59 percent, to close at 3,091.89, off 3,127.19, an intra-day high. The 50-stock index of the NSE lost 3.43 points, or 0.39 percent, to end at 880.95.
SBI fell 2.75 rupees to 225.25, Reliance 3.25 to 201.75, TISCO 2.75 to 163.0, BSES 3.0 to 207.50, TELCO 2.75 to 339.0, Bajaj Auto 3.50 to 840.0 and Indian Hotels 19.0 to 711.25.
However, ACC gained 5.50 to 1,190.25, ITC 6.25 to 303.0, MTNL 2.75 to 238.0 and Colgate 7.50 to 235.0.
